notes.title: Cards and Hats Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hellooo, Mates![/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] New Duel Mode! [u][b]Hardcore mode[/b][/u] challenges your aim and also gives you random cards with unique moves!
[*] New hats for the RubberDucks and [u][b]many more hats are coming![/b][/u]
[*] New Gun, better [u][b]game feel[/b][/u] and also a [u][b]better scenario post-processing[/b][/u] for the 360Duel.
[/list]

[h2]Everything looks much more polished; more skill-based gameplay and what really matters for you; more fun with friends ;)
[/h2]
